A large outbreak of Bundibugyo virus disease is taking place in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
(DRC) and Uganda. Although information remains limited, we assess the likelihood of infection for
people living in the EU/EEA to be very low.

### WELCOME MESSAGE

Dear Friends and Colleagues,

It our great pleasure to host the 33rd European Congress on Obesity (ECO 2026) in Istanbul, Türkiye,
from 12–15 May 2026.

We are working with great enthusiasm to develop an innovative and interactive scientific programme
that reflects the dynamic and multidisciplinary nature of obesity research and management. The
programme will address the most pressing and emerging topics in the field, fostering lively
discussion, knowledge exchange, and collaboration among clinicians, researchers, and public health
professionals. Advanced digital solutions will be implemented at ECO2026 to enhance access to
scientific content and to facilitate meaningful networking opportunities.

The congress structure will be designed to maximise engagement between delegates and faculty. The
programme will include plenary lectures, thematic sessions, teaching workshops, and moderated
research communication sessions. As in previous years, topics will be organised into four main
tracks: ‘Basic Science’; ‘Behavioural Science and Public Health’; ‘Childhood and Adolescent
Obesity’; and ‘Obesity Management and Intervention’.

We are honoured to welcome leading experts from across the globe who will share their insights and
latest findings. At the same time, we also greatly appreciate your contributions to the scientific
programme as you join us in shaping the discussions that will define the future of obesity science
and care.

Istanbul, a city where continents meet, offers a unique setting that bridges cultures, history, and
innovation. We are confident that ECO 2026 will not only provide an outstanding scientific
experience but also an unforgettable opportunity to connect with colleagues in one of the world’s
most vibrant and historic cities.

On behalf of the Executive and Organising Committees, we very much look forward to welcoming you to
Istanbul in May 2026 for what promises to be an inspiring and enriching congress.

With kind regards,

** Prof. Dilek Yazıcı
*Congress President* **
** Prof. Volkan Yumuk
*EASO President* **

tracks: ‘Basic Science’; ‘Behavioural Science and Public Health’; ‘Childhood and Adolescent
Obesity’; and ‘Obesity Management and Intervention’.

We are honoured to welcome leading experts from across the globe who will share their insights and
latest findings. At the same time, we also greatly appreciate your contributions to the scientific
programme as you join us in shaping the discussions that will define the future of obesity science
and care.

Istanbul, a city where continents meet, offers a unique setting that bridges cultures, history, and
innovation. We are confident that ECO 2026 will not only provide an outstanding scientific
experience but also an unforgettable opportunity to connect with colleagues in one of the world’s
most vibrant and historic cities.

On behalf of the Executive and Organising Committees, we very much look forward to welcoming you to
Istanbul in May 2026 for what promises to be an inspiring and enriching congress.

With kind regards,

** Prof. Dilek Yazıcı
*Congress President* **
** Prof. Volkan Yumuk

## Ihr zuverlässiger Partner für Kabel, Kunststoffrohre und Schaumstoffe

In den drei Geschäftsfeldern Eupen Cable, Eupen Pipe und Eupen Foam entwickelt und produziert
Kabelwerk Eupen AG hochwertige Kabel, Kunststoffrohre und Schaumstoffe. Mit jahrzehntelanger
Erfahrung zählt unser Unternehmen in den drei vorgenannten Bereichen zu den führenden Herstellern in
Europa.

** **

[[Video laden]][49]

Eupen Cable stellt seit mehr als 110 Jahren erfolgreich erstklassige Kabel und Leitungen für Energie
und Telekommunikation her und liefert die Produkte in über 70 Länder. Eupen Pipe überzeugt mit einer
breiten Produktpalette temperaturbeständiger PVC- und Polyethylenrohre für Gas-, Wasser-,
Abwasseranwendungen und für den Kabelschutz. Eupen Foam liefert Schaumstoffe als Blockware oder
Zuschnitte nach Kundenwunsch schwerpunktmäßig an die Branchen Bedding und Möbel und auch für die
Bereiche Medizin, Verpackung und Industrie.

Unsere lokalen Tugenden sind unsere globale Stärke. Traditionell mit „Made in EUPEN“ verknüpfte
Werte wie Qualität, Sicherheit, Seriosität, Termintreue und Zuverlässigkeit finden Zuspruch auf der
ganzen Welt. Unsere Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen zu entsprechen und Erwartungen kompromisslos zu
erfüllen, macht Kabelwerk Eupen AG zu einem zuverlässigen und langfristigen Partner für zahlreiche
nationale und internationale Unternehmen.

## Projektbesuch Stuttgart 21 – High-Tech-Infrastruktur live erlebt

Letzten Monat hatten wir die Gelegenheit, das beeindruckende Großprojekt Stuttgart 21 vor Ort zu
besuchen. Die neuen Tunnelanlagen sowie der neue Tiefbahnhof bieten nicht nur enorme bauliche
Dimensionen, sondern zeigen auch, wie modernste Kommunikationsinfrastruktur in Zukunft den
Bahnbetrieb unterstützen wird.

Ein zentraler Baustein dabei: die Strahlerkabel des Kabelwerkes Eupen. Die Frequenzband-optimierten
Koaxial-Strahlerkabel sind speziell für Tunnelumgebungen entwickelt und sorgen für eine stabile,
gleichmäßige Funkabdeckung für BOS-, Betriebs- und Mobilfunkdienste.

Die fachgerechte Installation erfolgt durch die EQOS Kommunikation, deren Team mit technischem
Know-how unter den anspruchsvollen Bedingungen im Tunnelbau die Kabelsysteme montiert, misst und in
die Gesamtinfrastruktur integriert.

Fazit: Ein beeindruckender Einblick in ein Schlüsselprojekt der künftigen Mobilität – und ein
Beispiel dafür, wie hochwertige Technik und professionelle Umsetzung Hand in Hand gehen. [weitere
Bilder][51]

[Zuklappen][52]

## Ihr zuverlässiger Partner für Kabel, Kunststoffrohre und Schaumstoffe

In den drei Geschäftsfeldern Eupen Cable, Eupen Pipe und Eupen Foam entwickelt und produziert
Kabelwerk Eupen AG hochwertige Kabel, Kunststoffrohre und Schaumstoffe. Mit jahrzehntelanger
Erfahrung zählt unser Unternehmen in den drei vorgenannten Bereichen zu den führenden Herstellern in
Europa.

** **

[[Video laden]][49]

Eupen Cable stellt seit mehr als 110 Jahren erfolgreich erstklassige Kabel und Leitungen für Energie
und Telekommunikation her und liefert die Produkte in über 70 Länder. Eupen Pipe überzeugt mit einer
breiten Produktpalette temperaturbeständiger PVC- und Polyethylenrohre für Gas-, Wasser-,
Abwasseranwendungen und für den Kabelschutz. Eupen Foam liefert Schaumstoffe als Blockware oder
Zuschnitte nach Kundenwunsch schwerpunktmäßig an die Branchen Bedding und Möbel und auch für die
Bereiche Medizin, Verpackung und Industrie.

Unsere lokalen Tugenden sind unsere globale Stärke. Traditionell mit „Made in EUPEN“ verknüpfte
Werte wie Qualität, Sicherheit, Seriosität, Termintreue und Zuverlässigkeit finden Zuspruch auf der
ganzen Welt. Unsere Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen zu entsprechen und Erwartungen kompromisslos zu
erfüllen, macht Kabelwerk Eupen AG zu einem zuverlässigen und langfristigen Partner für zahlreiche
nationale und internationale Unternehmen.

## Aktuelles

### InnoTrans 2026

Vom 22. bis zum 25. September 2026 ist es wieder soweit: die InnoTrans, die internationale Leitmesse
für Verkehrstechnik, öffnet ihre Türen in Berlin und auch wir sind wieder dabei! Besuchen Sie uns in
** Halle 12 ** auf **Stand 150 ** – wir freuen uns auf spannende & konstruktive Gespräche rund um:

**Tunnelfunkkabel, Energiekabel, Eisenbahnsignalkabel, Brandsicherheitskabel**

### Nachruf

In tiefer Trauer nehmen wir Abschied von unserem Präsidenten und Vorsitzenden des Verwaltungsrates**
Herrn Alfred Bourseaux**.

[ Nachruf ][50]

## Projektbesuch Stuttgart 21 – High-Tech-Infrastruktur live erlebt

Letzten Monat hatten wir die Gelegenheit, das beeindruckende Großprojekt Stuttgart 21 vor Ort zu
besuchen. Die neuen Tunnelanlagen sowie der neue Tiefbahnhof bieten nicht nur enorme bauliche
Dimensionen, sondern zeigen auch, wie modernste Kommunikationsinfrastruktur in Zukunft den
Bahnbetrieb unterstützen wird.

Ein zentraler Baustein dabei: die Strahlerkabel des Kabelwerkes Eupen. Die Frequenzband-optimierten
Koaxial-Strahlerkabel sind speziell für Tunnelumgebungen entwickelt und sorgen für eine stabile,
gleichmäßige Funkabdeckung für BOS-, Betriebs- und Mobilfunkdienste.

Die fachgerechte Installation erfolgt durch die EQOS Kommunikation, deren Team mit technischem
Know-how unter den anspruchsvollen Bedingungen im Tunnelbau die Kabelsysteme montiert, misst und in
die Gesamtinfrastruktur integriert.

Fazit: Ein beeindruckender Einblick in ein Schlüsselprojekt der künftigen Mobilität – und ein
Beispiel dafür, wie hochwertige Technik und professionelle Umsetzung Hand in Hand gehen. [weitere
Bilder][51]

[Zuklappen][52]

Beitrag zur Ressourcenschonung.
Gemeinsam tragen wir auf diesem Weg dazu bei, **Treibhausgase zu reduzieren** und die
Kreislaufwirtschaft weiter voranzutreiben.

# Home

## EURAXESS - researchers in motion

### The leading portal for the research community

Are you a researcher ready to take your career to the next level by moving to another country?
Do you represent a research performing organisation in search of top talent?
Look no further! Join the EURAXESS network to access free personalised information and assistance.

[Female scientist working in a laboratory with protective eyewear, illustrating EURAXESS career
development for researchers in Europe.]

### New on EURAXESS

**As part of the Choose Europe for Science initiative, you can now explore national and regional
funding and support schemes available across 27 EU Member States! **

[Explore now][33]

## SEARCH OUR DATABASE

Search
Receive job alerts and much more…

Log in to your EURAXESS account to manage your alerts for new/expiring offers, save your favourite
jobs, searches, and more.

[Log in ][34][Create a free account ][35]

## EURAXESS IN A NUTSHELL

[Close-up of binoculars emerging through yellow paper, illustrating EURAXESS focus on finding
research opportunities in Europe.]

### [The largest database of job, funding and hosting offers in Europe][36]

With 43 European countries and 9 worldwide hubs, EURAXESS is the largest pan-European initiative to
foster researchers’ mobility and career development. We strengthen scientific collaboration between
Europe and the global community, opening doors to endless possibilities for researchers worldwide.

[Job, Funding and Hosting Opportunities][37]
[Concept image of wooden blocks arranged as rising steps with an arrow, representing EURAXESS
support for researcher growth and career development in Europe.]

### [Expert career guidance][38]

Enhance your career with practical insights, free tools and resources to shape your professional
path. Connect with our knowledgeable staff to help you achieve your goals.

[Find out more][39]
[Hand connecting wooden blocks with human icons linked by white lines on a yellow background,
symbolising the network of EURAXESS Service Centres across Europe supporting researchers and
organisations.]

### [EURAXESS Service Centres][40]

More than 600 Service Centres located in 43 European countries offer free personalised assistance to
researchers and research performing organisations on a variety of relevant topics, from relocation
to career development services.

[Find a EURAXESS Service Centre][41]

## THE BENEFITS OF REGISTERING WITH EURAXESS

[Wooden figure holding a sign with a red question mark on a bright yellow background, symbolising a
researcher seeking guidance and opportunities.]
I am a researcher. What can EURAXESS do for me?

Whether you're seeking advice on career development, looking for tools to enhance your skills, or
need concrete assistance with relocating for your next big opportunity, EURAXESS can help. No matter
what stage of your research path or scientific business you are at, EURAXESS is a comprehensive
career and innovation hub for information and assistance. Find jobs, hosting and funding
opportunities, as well as support and guidance.

[Create your profile][42]
[Icons on wooden blocks symbolising recruitment, innovation, and collaboration, representing how
EURAXESS supports organisations in attracting top research talent.]
I represent an organisation. How can EURAXESS help?

Whether you represent a research institution, university, or business, EURAXESS can enhance your
recruitment process. Easily publish your vacancies for free and reach top-tier candidates in Europe
and beyond. Boost your visibility in the research community and attract the best minds to your
organisation.

Are you looking to expand your career development service portfolio? We can help you do so as well!

[Discover more][43]

# Home

## EURAXESS - researchers in motion

### The leading portal for the research community

Are you a researcher ready to take your career to the next level by moving to another country?
Do you represent a research performing organisation in search of top talent?
Look no further! Join the EURAXESS network to access free personalised information and assistance.

[Female scientist working in a laboratory with protective eyewear, illustrating EURAXESS career
development for researchers in Europe.]

### New on EURAXESS

**As part of the Choose Europe for Science initiative, you can now explore national and regional
funding and support schemes available across 27 EU Member States! **

[Explore now][33]

Search
Receive job alerts and much more…

jobs, searches, and more.

[Log in ][34][Create a free account ][35]

## EURAXESS IN A NUTSHELL

[Close-up of binoculars emerging through yellow paper, illustrating EURAXESS focus on finding
research opportunities in Europe.]

### [The largest database of job, funding and hosting offers in Europe][36]

With 43 European countries and 9 worldwide hubs, EURAXESS is the largest pan-European initiative to
foster researchers’ mobility and career development. We strengthen scientific collaboration between
Europe and the global community, opening doors to endless possibilities for researchers worldwide.

[Job, Funding and Hosting Opportunities][37]
[Concept image of wooden blocks arranged as rising steps with an arrow, representing EURAXESS
support for researcher growth and career development in Europe.]

### [Expert career guidance][38]

Enhance your career with practical insights, free tools and resources to shape your professional
path. Connect with our knowledgeable staff to help you achieve your goals.

[Find out more][39]
[Hand connecting wooden blocks with human icons linked by white lines on a yellow background,
symbolising the network of EURAXESS Service Centres across Europe supporting researchers and
organisations.]

### [EURAXESS Service Centres][40]

More than 600 Service Centres located in 43 European countries offer free personalised assistance to
researchers and research performing organisations on a variety of relevant topics, from relocation
to career development services.

[Find a EURAXESS Service Centre][41]

## THE BENEFITS OF REGISTERING WITH EURAXESS

[Wooden figure holding a sign with a red question mark on a bright yellow background, symbolising a
researcher seeking guidance and opportunities.]
I am a researcher. What can EURAXESS do for me?

Whether you're seeking advice on career development, looking for tools to enhance your skills, or
need concrete assistance with relocating for your next big opportunity, EURAXESS can help. No matter
what stage of your research path or scientific business you are at, EURAXESS is a comprehensive
career and innovation hub for information and assistance. Find jobs, hosting and funding
opportunities, as well as support and guidance.

[Create your profile][42]
[Icons on wooden blocks symbolising recruitment, innovation, and collaboration, representing how
EURAXESS supports organisations in attracting top research talent.]
I represent an organisation. How can EURAXESS help?

Whether you represent a research institution, university, or business, EURAXESS can enhance your
recruitment process. Easily publish your vacancies for free and reach top-tier candidates in Europe
and beyond. Boost your visibility in the research community and attract the best minds to your
organisation.

Are you looking to expand your career development service portfolio? We can help you do so as well!

[Discover more][43]

highly specialized small- and medium sized businesses from across Europe.

We empower Europe’s sustainable electrification and digitalisation.

# Practical tools and knowledge for exporting companies

[Business people in harbour]

## HS Code validation

Almost every country or trade block in the world has its own detailing on the international HS-code
list. With our report you strongly reduce the risk on misclassifications, delays and higher custom
duties than expected.

[ Get your report ][33]

## Export knowledge

Our article database covers over 30 countries and several topics such as custom regulations,
distributor search, taxation issues and commercial advice. 

[ Check our articles ][34]

## Find service providers

We keep a database with export service providers in various countries. They can help you with market
entry, imports & exports,  company incorporation or other topics.

[ Find a provider ][35]

Any other questions? Email us at [info@exporteers.com][36].

# **High-voltage cable installation & jointing specialists**

Delivering HV Electrical Engineering Solutions to the UK’s onshore & offshore power networks 

[Electrical substation electrical installation]

## High-voltage specialists

Global Power Services is a high-voltage cable installation and jointing specialist operating in the
power and utilities infrastructure sector. 

With decades of experience across the team we are firmly established as a trusted partner to tier 1
operators servicing the onshore and offshore power distribution networks across the UK and Europe. 

[ About ][43]
[Shot Blasting]

## Skilled project delivery

Global Power Services’ leadership team – supported by our skilled and experienced on-site project
teams - brings extensive expertise and a strong track record.

With teams based across the UK and Europe, our core capabilities include Project Management, Duct &
Cable Installation, Cable Jointing, Project Planning, Testing Fibre Installation, Shot Blasting,
Complex Steelwork Installations and Civil & Foundation Installation.  

[ Services ][44]
[Vanguard 1]

## Proven track record

As a long term preferred framework contractor, we are a key supplier to the build out and upgrade of
the UK power networks - including HV commissioning for renewable energy projects. 

Since 2009 we have delivered a range of HV cable schemes (up to 400kV) for all major network
providers, including National Grid, Western Power Distribution, Northern Power Grid, Scottish &
Southern Energy (SSE) and UK Power Networks.

# **High-voltage cable installation & jointing specialists**

Delivering HV Electrical Engineering Solutions to the UK’s onshore & offshore power networks 

[Electrical substation electrical installation]

## High-voltage specialists

Global Power Services is a high-voltage cable installation and jointing specialist operating in the
power and utilities infrastructure sector. 

With decades of experience across the team we are firmly established as a trusted partner to tier 1
operators servicing the onshore and offshore power distribution networks across the UK and Europe. 

[ About ][43]
[Shot Blasting]

## Skilled project delivery

Global Power Services’ leadership team – supported by our skilled and experienced on-site project
teams - brings extensive expertise and a strong track record.

With teams based across the UK and Europe, our core capabilities include Project Management, Duct &
Cable Installation, Cable Jointing, Project Planning, Testing Fibre Installation, Shot Blasting,
Complex Steelwork Installations and Civil & Foundation Installation.  

[ Services ][44]
[Vanguard 1]

## Proven track record

As a long term preferred framework contractor, we are a key supplier to the build out and upgrade of
the UK power networks - including HV commissioning for renewable energy projects. 

Since 2009 we have delivered a range of HV cable schemes (up to 400kV) for all major network
providers, including National Grid, Western Power Distribution, Northern Power Grid, Scottish &
Southern Energy (SSE) and UK Power Networks.

* [ ** जनसुनवाई - समाधान पोर्टल ][40]
* [ ** एंड्रॉइड एप्लिकेशन ][41]
* ### शिकायत पंजीकरण
  
  जनसुनवाई पोर्टल मोबाइल ओटीपी के माध्यम से आसान पंजीकरण की सुविधा प्रदान करता है और किसी भी समय सरकार के हर
  स्तर पर शिकायत को हल करने की सुविदा प्राप्त करता हैI
* ### शिकायत की स्थिति
  
  पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर / ईमेल आईडी के माध्यम से शिकायत को ट्रैक करें।
  [ मोबाइल नंबर से पंजीकृत शिकायतें प्राप्त करें][42]
* ### अनुस्मारक भेजें
  
  निर्धारित समय में शिकायत का समाधान नहीं होने पर शिकायतकर्ता रिमाइंडर भेज सकता है।
* ### आपकी प्रतिक्रिया
  
  जनसुनवाई पोर्टल निस्तारण की गुणवत्ता के बारे में प्रतिक्रिया देने की सुविधा प्रदान करता है, जिसका मूल्यांकन उच्च
  अधिकारियों द्वारा किया जाता है और वे निस्तारित किये गए संदर्भो को पुनः जीवित कर सकते हैं।

[dashboard-demo-icon]

  1. मोबाइल गवर्नेंस के दृष्टिगत जनसुनवाई एंड्राइड मोबाइल ऐप का निर्माण किया गया है I
  2. इस मोबाइल ऐप का उपयोग कर नागरिक आसानी से किसी भी समय अपनी शिकायत को दर्ज एवं ट्रैक कर सकते हैं I

#### Certified Company

High voltage cable joints manufacturer, **Jointmask** is a certified Company, specialising in
Development, Manufacturing & Marketing of [heat shrinkable jointing kits][14] upto 66 kV.

#### Why Us

Our products find application in power distribution, electrical Insulation, industries &
applications. We have never received any major query or feedback regarding product quality that is
itself a great achievement.

#### Vision

Our company is committed to provide world class products, not only meeting the required standards
and values but exceeding them comfortably. Also, our products are manufactured by using quality
assured materials.

### Product Highlights

COLD SHRINK STRAIGHT JOINTS:
CSS-1133 Series.
The JOINTMASK Cold Shrink terminations provide stress control by utilizing a flexible tube with a
high permittivity dielectric constant.


Tinned / Bare Copper Mesh Tape
We offer wide range of Wire Mesh, jointless, continuous and with uniform borders in various sized,
thickness and width as per customer requirements.


HEAT SHRINK CABLE END CAPS JEC - SERIES :
Heat Shrink Cable End Caps are used to seal the ends of all types of Cables & protect from ingress
of water/moisture. The caps are manufactured from high quality cross linked polyolefin material.


HEAT SHRINK HT BRAKOUT HVB-1133 SERIES :
Heat Shrink Anti Tracking Cable Breakout provide permanent environmental seal to the crutch of 3
core XLPE & PILC cable rating upto 36KV.


HEAT SHRINK RAIN SHED/SKIRT JRS- 1133 SERIES :
Heat Shrink Creepage Extension Skirts are used to increase the surface creepage distance of the
cores of the cable termination without increasing the tail length.


BLACK SEALING MASTIC TAPE :
Preventing leaks of resin ,Particularly suitable for hot climate ,Waterproofing of LV & MV joints.
Reconstruction of LV insulation.


YELLOW MASTIC TAPE :
Preventing leaks of resin, ,Waterproofing of LV & MV joints. Filling voids in joints & terminations.
For stress relief in MV joints & termination.


PUSH ON END TERMINATION INDOOR / OUTDOOR MEPI/MEPO – 1133 SERIES :
JOINTMASK PUSH ON system comprises of precisely engineered and molded EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene
Monomer) Rubber Components.


Tinned / Bare Copper Braids
Single & multiple flat braids can be used as continuous current carrying conductors. Flexible
connectors / shunts / links / assemblies enable transfer of high current by using component with
smaller dimension.

**Jointmask** is committed to supply World Class products, not only meeting the required standards &

#### Certified Company

High voltage cable joints manufacturer, **Jointmask** is a certified Company, specialising in
Development, Manufacturing & Marketing of [heat shrinkable jointing kits][14] upto 66 kV.

#### Why Us

Our products find application in power distribution, electrical Insulation, industries &
applications. We have never received any major query or feedback regarding product quality that is
itself a great achievement.

#### Vision

Our company is committed to provide world class products, not only meeting the required standards
and values but exceeding them comfortably. Also, our products are manufactured by using quality
assured materials.

### Product Highlights

COLD SHRINK STRAIGHT JOINTS:
CSS-1133 Series.
The JOINTMASK Cold Shrink terminations provide stress control by utilizing a flexible tube with a
high permittivity dielectric constant.


Tinned / Bare Copper Mesh Tape
We offer wide range of Wire Mesh, jointless, continuous and with uniform borders in various sized,
thickness and width as per customer requirements.


HEAT SHRINK CABLE END CAPS JEC - SERIES :
Heat Shrink Cable End Caps are used to seal the ends of all types of Cables & protect from ingress
of water/moisture. The caps are manufactured from high quality cross linked polyolefin material.


HEAT SHRINK HT BRAKOUT HVB-1133 SERIES :
Heat Shrink Anti Tracking Cable Breakout provide permanent environmental seal to the crutch of 3
core XLPE & PILC cable rating upto 36KV.


HEAT SHRINK RAIN SHED/SKIRT JRS- 1133 SERIES :
Heat Shrink Creepage Extension Skirts are used to increase the surface creepage distance of the
cores of the cable termination without increasing the tail length.


BLACK SEALING MASTIC TAPE :
Preventing leaks of resin ,Particularly suitable for hot climate ,Waterproofing of LV & MV joints.
Reconstruction of LV insulation.


YELLOW MASTIC TAPE :
Preventing leaks of resin, ,Waterproofing of LV & MV joints. Filling voids in joints & terminations.
For stress relief in MV joints & termination.


PUSH ON END TERMINATION INDOOR / OUTDOOR MEPI/MEPO – 1133 SERIES :
JOINTMASK PUSH ON system comprises of precisely engineered and molded EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene
Monomer) Rubber Components.


Tinned / Bare Copper Braids
Single & multiple flat braids can be used as continuous current carrying conductors. Flexible
connectors / shunts / links / assemblies enable transfer of high current by using component with
smaller dimension.

### Social

When is the best time to book?
Three months in advance! It’s when most carriers release their tickets (apart from Eurostar – look
for Eurostar tickets six months in advance).

Want to get the best price for your journey? Book early. Prices normally go up closer to the
departure date.

Plus, you might not get seats together if you book late (which might be a bonus for the introverts
out there).
Can I cancel my booking?
It depends on the company the booking was made with and on the type of ticket purchased. If sale
conditions allow it, you can easily cancel your booking online.
Can I request a refund for my ticket?
You can request a refund after canceling your booking, if allowed by the ticket terms and
conditions. You can also receive a refund if your train is canceled, and in some cases of delays, by
the train company.

Who are we?
Born in 1997, Trainline is a tech company with the mission to make booking of train and bus tickets
easier, reach new destinations and promote a more sustainable travel sector.

We offer affordable solutions and travel information in real time, displaying routes, prices and
timetables of more than 270 train and bus companies in 45 countries.
When is the best time to book?
Three months in advance! It’s when most carriers release their tickets (apart from Eurostar – look
for Eurostar tickets six months in advance).

Want to get the best price for your journey? Book early. Prices normally go up closer to the
departure date.

Plus, you might not get seats together if you book late (which might be a bonus for the introverts
out there).
Can I cancel my booking?
It depends on the company the booking was made with and on the type of ticket purchased. If sale
conditions allow it, you can easily cancel your booking online.
Can I request a refund for my ticket?
You can request a refund after canceling your booking, if allowed by the ticket terms and
conditions. You can also receive a refund if your train is canceled, and in some cases of delays, by
the train company.

Our Products
* 1. [Heat Shrink Kits][11]
  2. [[Heat Shrink Kits]][12] This cable joint is applicable to cables with different cross sections
     and different cores, including single-core cables, two-core cables, three-core cables,
     four-core cables and five-core cables.
* 1. [Heat Shrink Tubing][13]
  2. [[Heat Shrink Tubing]][14]This heat shrinkable tube is applicable to cables up to 42kV. To be
     specific, it protects cables inside and avoids accidental flashover. The operating temperature
     ranges from 90℃ to 130℃.
* 1. [Heat Shrink Moulded Shapes][15]
  2. [[Heat Shrink Moulded Shapes]][16]This heat shrink anti-tracking rain shed is used for
     extending the creepage path for cable terminations. It is made of quality polyolefin that
     ensures excellent insulation performance.
* 1. [Cold Shrink Tubing][17]
  2. [[Cold Shrink Tubing]][18]This EPDM cold shrink tube is aimed to seal and protect against
     chemical corrosion communication cables, coaxial cables and LV&MV cables. It is easy to install
     and the shrinkage requires no flame nor heating.
* 1. [Cold Shrink Moulded Shapes][19]
  2. [[Cold Shrink Moulded Shapes]][20]This cold shrink silicone rubber breakout creates an
     environmental enclosure for cable phase and overall cable jacket. It is expanded and mounted on
     removable inner supporting plastic cores in factories.
* 1. [Separable Connector (European Standard)][21]
  2. [[Separable Connector (European Standard)]][22]This connector set includes a separable
     connector that links cables to interface C bushings, like transformers and switchgears, and a
     rear connector to work as a connector extension.
* 1. [Separable Connector (American Standard)][23]
  2. [[Separable Connector (American Standard)]][24]Compatible jointing devices include single
     feed-thru bushing, dual feed-thru bushing, 200A interface for bus bar, 200A interface for etc.
* 1. [Inner Cone Plug-In Termination][25]
  2. [[Inner Cone Plug-In Termination]][26]The product dimensions fulfill EN-50181 design standard
     and the product performance is in compliance with GB/T28427-2012 standard. The fitting adopts
     dual contact band design to allow a larger discharge capacity.
